4063.name: CD4063: 4-bit comparator. Project: implement bit-serial comparator using basic gates and compare it with this combinational comparator.

4555.name: CD4555: Dual Binary to 1-of-4 Decoder/Demultiplexer. Project: decoder + selector = mux. Compare with 4028 decoder.

4017.name: CD4017: Decade counter with decoded outputs. Demonstrate Johnson counter, compare it with same thing build using 4015 shift register and 4069 inverter.

4019.name: CD4019: Four AND/OR selectors with two shared enables

4032.name: CD4032: Triple serial adder, combine it with parallel-to-serial 4014 and serial-to-parallel 4015, and compare this way of doing addition to the combinational adder 4008

jack5.name: Direct 2.1 mm barrel breakout, no regulator; 5 V only

cable5.name: USB-to-barrel cable marked 5 V; direct path

power.name: Breadboard regulator module, output set to 5 V

button.name: Individual 3-pin button module with embedded pull resistor
button.note: Normalize the $2.03 five-module lot to $0.406/module. Confirm listing supplies modules with resistors, not bare switches.

mm.name: Male–male jumper, 10–15 cm
mm.note: Normalize the $1.30 pack to $0.0325 per lead.

mf.name: Male–female jumper, 10–15 cm
mf.note: Normalize the $1.30 pack to $0.0325 per lead.

touch.name: TTP223 assembled capacitive touch switch, self-locking / toggle mode
touch.note: Explicitly requested in review1; USD 0.25/module is an unverified budgeting assumption, not a retrieved listing price. Supply with pins fitted and toggle mode already selected.

exercises.title: Power, breadboard, LED and button
exercises.goal: Identify connected rows and split rails; light the special 5 V LED and measure the button’s idle/pressed levels.

exercises.title: XOR truth table
exercises.goal: Measure every input combination; record the output as 0 or 1.

exercises.title: AND truth table
exercises.goal: Measure every input combination; record the output as 0 or 1.

exercises.title: OR truth table
exercises.goal: Measure every input combination; record the output as 0 or 1.

exercises.title: NOT truth table
exercises.goal: Measure every input combination; record the output as 0 or 1.

exercises.title: Both De Morgan identities
exercises.goal: Compare ¬(A∧B) with ¬A∨¬B, and ¬(A∨B) with ¬A∧¬B. Rewire between the two comparisons.

exercises.title: D flip-flop with asynchronous reset
exercises.goal: Change D between rising clock edges; Q must hold. Reset must clear Q without waiting for a clock.

exercises.title: Binary / BCD up-down counter
exercises.goal: Count in both directions; compare binary wrap at 15 with BCD wrap at 9. Preset data uses rail patch leads.

exercises.title: Serial-in, parallel-out register
exercises.goal: Cascade the two 4-bit sections; follow a single 1 through eight positions.

exercises.title: Seven-segment exploration and BCD display
exercises.goal: Map a–g with one 560 Ω resistor per segment, then show 0–9 using 4511.
exercises.note: 4511 does not display hexadecimal A–F. Tie LE low and lamp-test/blanking inactive for transparent operation.

exercises.title: 4-bit adder with binary output
exercises.goal: Enter two 4-bit operands; show four sum bits and carry. Carry-in is tied low.

exercises.title: 4-bit adder with three decimal displays
exercises.goal: Display A, B and the low four sum bits simultaneously. Use bar channel 0 for carry.
exercises.note: For readable decimal digits choose A+B ≤9. For larger results inspect the binary LEDs or use the separate DM9368 variant; three 4511s are not a binary-to-decimal converter.

exercises.title: Triple 3-input AND investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Dual 4-input AND investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Quad 2-input NAND investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Dual 4-input NAND investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Triple 3-input NAND investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: 8-input AND/NAND investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Quad 2-input NOR investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Dual 4-input NOR investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Triple 3-input NOR investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: 8-input NOR investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Dual 4-input OR investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Triple 3-input OR investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.

exercises.title: Quad 2-input XNOR (source typo corrected) investigation
exercises.goal: Use the selected gate and its datasheet to predict and check a truth table. Other gates in the same package can remain unused with inputs tied.
exercises.note: CD4077 has two inputs per XNOR gate, not three.

exercises.title: Half adder from gates
exercises.goal: Build sum=A XOR B and carry=A AND B; test all four input pairs.

exercises.title: Full adder from gates
exercises.goal: Use two XOR, two AND and one OR gates; verify all eight input triples.

exercises.title: 2-bit adder: half adder plus full adder
exercises.goal: Use a half adder for bit 0 and a full adder for bit 1. Verify 3+3=110; no external carry-in.

exercises.title: 8-bit parallel adder
exercises.goal: Cascade carry-out to carry-in. Set sixteen operand bits with rail patch leads; observe 8 sum bits and carry.

exercises.title: Configurable logic function
exercises.goal: Patch mode controls to fixed levels, then investigate how the same data inputs implement different functions.

exercises.title: Parallel-in, serial-out register
exercises.goal: Patch an 8-bit parallel word, load it on a clock edge, then shift and record the serial sequence.

exercises.title: 4-bit magnitude comparator
exercises.goal: Compare A and B; initialize cascade inputs to equal=1, less=greater=0.

exercises.title: 4051 multiplexer
exercises.goal: Patch fixed data patterns, vary select inputs and observe selected channels.
exercises.note: 405x: VEE=GND for 0–5 V signals, INH low. 4019: complementary shared Ka/Kb select all four bits together.

exercises.title: 4052 multiplexer
exercises.goal: Patch fixed data patterns, vary select inputs and observe selected channels.
exercises.note: 405x: VEE=GND for 0–5 V signals, INH low. 4019: complementary shared Ka/Kb select all four bits together.

exercises.title: 4053 multiplexer
exercises.goal: Patch fixed data patterns, vary select inputs and observe selected channels.
exercises.note: 405x: VEE=GND for 0–5 V signals, INH low. 4019: complementary shared Ka/Kb select all four bits together.

exercises.title: 4019 multiplexer
exercises.goal: Patch fixed data patterns, vary select inputs and observe selected channels.
exercises.note: 405x: VEE=GND for 0–5 V signals, INH low. 4019: complementary shared Ka/Kb select all four bits together.

exercises.title: BCD-to-decimal decoder
exercises.goal: Observe ten one-hot outputs for inputs 0–9; check the response to 10–15.

exercises.title: 8-to-3 priority encoder with decimal display
exercises.goal: Assert multiple requests and show the highest selected input number; show valid status separately.

exercises.title: Decoded decade counter
exercises.goal: Follow the single active output through Q0–Q9; reset to Q0.

exercises.title: Single FIFO with clock, push/pop and four data switches
exercises.goal: Set a 4-bit word with four self-locking TTP223 switches. PUSH and POP are requests sampled with the assembled clock; observe Q[3:0], EMPTY and FULL.
exercises.note: Two operational buttons: PUSH and POP. Initialize MR with a rail jumper. Six channels of one 8-LED bar are used. AND/inverter quantities budget clock/command logic and flag polarity; the FIFO pin-level timing adapter remains to be verified.

exercises.title: 4 × 4 register file
exercises.goal: Patch addresses and use data/write controls to store and read four independent words.
exercises.note: Rare CD40108 required; no substitute silently assumed. Confirm manufacturer pinout and read/write timing before the lesson.

exercises.title: 4-bit ALU
exercises.goal: Select addition, subtraction and a logic operation. Patch function controls from the actual datasheet; input 8 operand bits plus mode.
exercises.note: Rare CD40181 required; a 74LS181 is not an automatic electrical or pin-for-pin substitute.

exercises.title: 4051 replaced by decoder + AND/OR
exercises.goal: Tie decoder bit 3 low; gate eight fixed data bits with decoded selects and OR the terms. Compare against C04 by rewiring.

exercises.title: 4051 replaced by decoder + AND-OR-INVERT
exercises.goal: Use two four-term 4086 sections, invert each output and OR them. Compare against C04 by rewiring.
exercises.note: One 4086 contains one four-term AOI function; an 8:1 replacement needs two. Set each enable high and inhibit low.

exercises.title: 4052 replaced by decoder + AND/OR
exercises.goal: Decode the two select bits for two channels. Each channel uses four AND terms and one 4-input OR; compare with C05.

exercises.title: 4052 replaced by decoder + AND-OR-INVERT
exercises.goal: Use one 4086 per 4:1 channel and invert both outputs; compare with C05.

exercises.title: 4019 vector selection and gate equivalent
exercises.goal: Compare Y=(A AND {4{Ka}}) OR (B AND {4{Kb}}) for two 4-bit vectors, using common enables.
exercises.note: The source calls this a bit-mask merge. 4019 has shared enables, not four independent mask bits. For an arbitrary 4-bit mask use the included 8 AND + 4 OR + 4 NOT gates and rail-patched mask bits; one 4019 alone cannot implement that version.

exercises.title: Johnson counter from shift register
exercises.goal: Use four stages with inverted last-stage feedback. Observe eight states; compare with the fixed 10-state CD4017 by rebuilding C10.

exercises.title: Serial adder with serializers and three displays
exercises.goal: Patch two operands; load both 4014s, reset carry, then shift into 4032 and collect the result in 4015. Show three low nibbles through 4511.
exercises.note: Start with operands whose sum is ≤9 for the three decimal displays. Label bit order and count exactly eight shift edges. Carry reset and load timing depend on the 4032/4014 datasheets; prove timing before a class.

exercises.title: Serial adder with discrete carry register
exercises.goal: Replace the 4032 of P01 with the A02 full adder and one 4013 for carry; preserve the serializer, output register and displays.
exercises.note: Rising-edge registers capture the pre-edge sum and carry. Reset carry before the first bit; load the serializers separately from the shift phase.

exercises.title: Automatic three-FIFO adder with backpressure
exercises.goal: At each clock cycle, enqueue A and B independently. Automatically consume their oldest pair and enqueue the sum when both are available and the result FIFO can accept it.
exercises.note: Three operational controls: A_VALID, B_VALID and SUM_READY. Data[3:0] for each operand and reset use rail jumpers. Target behavior is the supplied valid/ready RTL at width=4, depth=16. Gate quantities are a preliminary Boolean/clock-interface budget, not a completed 40105 pulse-adapter netlist.

exercises.title: Two-request round-robin arbiter
exercises.goal: Observe requests, grants and priority. The assembled clock accepts one grant each rising edge; persistent simultaneous requests alternate.
exercises.note: Four logic ICs. Buttons are r0, r1 and RESET. The assembled 555 module provides the clock directly.

exercises.title: Sequence recognizer: 01
exercises.goal: DATA is 1 while pressed and 0 while released. The assembled clock samples one bit per rising edge; RESET starts a new stream.
exercises.note: Reset seen_zero and MATCH to 0. seen_zero_next=NOT X; match_next=seen_zero AND X. Both 4013 halves use the assembled clock.

exercises.title: Custom 2–4 bit sequence FSM
exercises.goal: Set DATA before each rising edge of the assembled clock. Build a recognizer for a teacher-assigned binary pattern of length 2–4; show state and MATCH on LEDs.
exercises.note: Use 40174 for two state bits and registered MATCH. 4076 is the source alternative register. Three 4073s provide eight minterms; three 4072s plus one 4071 provide three 8-term OR trees. The custom task generator uses the same clocked input convention.

exercises.title: Bit-serial comparator, least-significant bit first
exercises.goal: On each rising edge of the assembled clock, overwrite greater/less for differing input bits or retain the comparison for equal bits. Reset both flags to 0.
exercises.note: Two data buttons and RESET. Equality=NOT(greater OR less). 4063 provides a four-bit reference comparison using rail-patched operands.

exercises.title: Bit-serial comparator, most-significant bit first
exercises.goal: On assembled-clock edges, latch the first differing input pair and ignore subsequent differences. Compare the final flags with 4063.

exercises.title: Cascaded 8-bit comparator
exercises.goal: Patch sixteen operand bits; cascade from the least-significant nibble to the most-significant comparator.

exercises.title: FSM comparing one nibble per clock
exercises.goal: Use 4063 for each input nibble pair and two state bits to remember the first unequal nibble. The assembled clock advances the comparison; RESET starts a word.
exercises.note: Eight data buttons and RESET. The least-significant-nibble-first variant overwrites the comparison on every unequal nibble.

exercises.title: Traffic-light FSM: 4 red, 2 yellow, 4 green
exercises.goal: OR Q0–Q3 for red, Q4–Q5 for yellow, Q6–Q9 for green. Count cycles and verify exactly one lamp is lit.

exercises.title: Compare binary and Johnson counter streams
exercises.goal: Clock a 4-bit binary counter and a 4-stage Johnson counter together; display both vectors and the greater/equal/less comparison.

exercises.title: Hexadecimal display with DM9368
exercises.goal: Wire the source’s DM9368 alternative to display hexadecimal operands and result.
exercises.note: DM9368 has its own pinout and integrated segment current sources; use its datasheet. The 560 Ω resistors belong to the 4511 version and are not fitted here.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: Every exercise in the July article’s Basics section, including three simultaneous decimal displays, plus the first-lesson De Morgan comparison.

comprehensive.title: Comprehensive
comprehensive.description: All explicitly described breadboard exercises and bounded variants in the two source lists, including rare ICs and the optional hexadecimal display.

fifo.title: Automatic three-FIFO adder
fifo.description: Two operand queues feed an adder and a result queue automatically, following the supplied SystemVerilog valid/ready design.

arbiter.title: Two-request round-robin arbiter
arbiter.description: A four-core-IC arbiter with requests, grants, retained priority, a slow assembled clock.

fsm.title: FSM and custom sequence tasks
fsm.description: A 01 starter and a configurable, overlapping recognizer for any 2–4 bit binary sequence. Includes an assembled clock and an offline task generator.

single_fifo.title: Single FIFO
single_fifo.description: One FIFO, assembled clock, PUSH/POP buttons, four TTP223 self-locking data switches and LEDs for 4-bit data, EMPTY and FULL.
